Served items:
- Greek yogurt, about 170 g: 160 kcal, 9 g protein, 8 g carbs, 10 g fat.
- Muesli, about 60 g: 230 kcal, 7 g protein, 38 g carbs, 6 g fat.
- Muffin, about 110 g: 400 kcal, 6 g protein, 50 g carbs, 19 g fat.
- Two fried eggs: 180 kcal, 13 g protein, 1 g carbs, 14 g fat.
- Coffee with milk, about 300 ml: 100 kcal, 5 g protein, 8 g carbs, 5 g fat.

Total served is about 1070 kcal.

Leftovers:
- About 30% of the muesli and some yogurt remain, roughly 90 kcal.
- A little muffin is stuck to the liner, about 10 kcal.
- The coffee is mostly left. The mug still looks almost full, perhaps a little consumed, so about 80 kcal remains.

Total left over is about 180 kcal, so about 890 kcal was eaten.

Eaten macros:
- Protein: about 9 (yogurt) + 13 (eggs) + 6 (muffin) + 5 (muesli, about 70%) + 1 (coffee) = 34 g.
- Carbs: about 8 + 1 + 49 + 27 + 2 = 87 g.
- Fat: about 10 + 14 + 18.5 + 4 + 1 = 47.5 g.
